title: Everyday, Love Me More
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: As a lonely Tokyo child visiting his grandmother each summer, Oto was befriended by Sora, two years older, who then vanished the next summer. Years later, as Sora starts his last year of high school wanting only to study for entrance exams, Oto reappears and declares his love (Futekiya/Fantasista blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). MangaUpdates lists family trouble (a stepmother, a dead parent), a long-distance stretch and a time skip to university.
life_message: Saying your feelings honestly, and keeping a promise, matters more than pride or fear.

content.note: Boys' Love; MU lists first-time intercourse, with a later time skip to university; MangaDex rating safe (batch data) (to verify).
